rosie.label: Princess Rosie (host)
rosie.description: A warm, gentle young British woman in her early twenties playing a kind fairytale princess for four-year-olds. Soft, bright and smiling, clear and unhurried, light southern English accent. A friendly storyteller, never squeaky or shrill.

cat.label: Whiskers the cat
cat.description: A playful, slightly mischievous young British voice for a cartoon kitten. Light and quick, giggly, with a little purr in it. Cute but clear enough for a small child to follow.

cook.label: Cook Crumble
cook.description: A jolly, round, warm middle-aged British woman who is the castle cook. Cosy northern English accent, chuckling, kind and a little flustered.

owl.label: Hoot the owl
owl.description: An elderly, gentle, slightly pompous British man playing a wise old owl. Soft, slow and thoughtful, a little absent-minded, very friendly.

dragon.label: Sparky the dragon
dragon.description: A big, friendly baby dragon. Deep but soft and rumbly young male voice, slow, goofy and sweet, never scary.

pony.label: Buttercup the pony
pony.description: A cheerful young woman's voice for a cartoon pony, bright and bouncy, with a soft West Country English accent.

unicorn.label: Moonbeam the unicorn
unicorn.description: A dreamy, sparkly, slightly breathy young British woman's voice for a magical unicorn. Airy, soft and full of wonder.

frog.label: Prince Ribbit the frog
frog.description: A posh, slightly croaky young British man who is a frog prince. Polite, comic and a little pompous.

fairy.label: Twinkle the fairy
fairy.description: A tiny, quick, tinkling fairy. A very light and bright young British woman's voice, giggly and fast, but still clear.

wizard.label: Wizard Wobble
wizard.description: A kindly, bumbling old British wizard. Warm, slightly wobbly grandfatherly voice, funny and gentle.
